title: Need to be able to opt out or change the monthly vinyl
text:
My only complaint about this record club is that there should be advance notice of the selection for the month and the opportunity to cancel it or exchange it for a different record. So far, I have been shipped two records that I already own. That just means I have to do a return. Highly inconvenient.

Maybe this record club is for people who are new to vinyl that do not already have a record collection from the 1960s-1770s.
label: neutral
